Hand-crafted fixture for ARX-CONSTRUCTS-367.

Covers `\cite{key}` resolved against a sibling `refs.bbl` containing a
`thebibliography` env. The construct test runner detects auxiliary files
(anything beyond input.tex/preamble.tex/expected.md/source.txt) and falls
back to `convert_path` against a tmp workdir so .bbl scanning at root_dir
can run.

Asserts:
- Inline `\cite{...}` renders as `[@key]` (existing CitationSpan behavior).
- Bibliography section "## References" emitted with one bullet per resolved
  bib entry, text taken from the `\bibitem` body in refs.bbl.

See src/arxiv_md/tex/bibliography.py::parse_bibliography (file-scan branch)
and src/arxiv_md/tex/rendering.py::_render_bib.
